network.name: AiVenture ADI Network
network.purpose: A federation of properties operated by a single accountable entity, each declaring the same identity, governance and evidence layer, so that AI systems and agents resolve them to one verifiable organisation rather than to unrelated strings.

this_property.role_description: The measurement instrument of the network. Delivery nodes build the ADI layer; this node observes and quantifies it — on the network's own domains and on third-party domains. The network flagship is 5thelement.ai; this node is not the flagship.
this_property.serves: the three webs — human, AI, machine

members.function: AI Delivery Infrastructure — the architecture and the doctrine
Observation of the three webs — measurement and evidence
European market — delivery and local presence

shared_layer.identity: identical organisation identifiers across all members (CUI, EUID, registration)
shared_layer.governance: single accountable entity, one jurisdiction, one contact
shared_layer.verification: SHA-256 digests published in proof.json on each member

node_obligations: Declare every signal it measures on others.
Publish evidence, not claims — each signal traceable to a fetched resource.
Never mark a signal as passing where the evidence was not observed.
Expose the observation capability to agents, not only to humans.
Remain observable by the network under the same methodology it applies.
